item.title: TTT 315: Shoot The Shit
item.description:
Guest Hosts: Nick, Candice

Nick & Candice from the Limited Release podcast lower themselves to our level and shoot the shit for an hour or so. It’s kind of like a regular show but with people who are clearly much smarter and talk less about what came out of their body. Also, Nick is sick of this Eurovision shit we usually play. It’s a tough sell. We get it, buddy.
